A '''vectral''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component designed to scatter and dampen exhaust emissions, thereby reducing a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] profile. [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] employed disk-shaped vectrals at the end of their [[Ion Jet engine]]s. The vectrals also served as a steering mechanism by redirecting the exhaust in flight to alter the ship's heading.<ref name="SWS" />
